resources.string:
Author: Group
Activity version: Version 1

The camera panel is above the text editor. Drag the divider to resize it or drag fully upward to close it. Closing the camera panel stops the camera and clears landmarks; Start Camera opens it again. Double-tap the divider to reset. The full camera frame stays visible as the panel changes size; dark margins are normal.

Tap Start Camera and allow camera access. Tracking draws 21 landmarks per hand. Sign A, E, I, O, or U with one hand and hold steady for half a second. Live recognition appears above the editor and does not replace typed or spoken text. Showing two hands keeps tracking available and asks for one hand for vowel recognition.

Type in the editor or tap Microphone to open the speech recognizer on your phone. Microphone stops the camera before opening voice input. Recognized speech replaces the editor text and can be edited. Cancelling voice input keeps the existing text. Voice availability and offline support depend on the device speech service.

Text and panel size survive rotation. Leaving Home, backgrounding, or logging out releases the camera; tap Start Camera to restart. Switch Camera changes front/rear when available. Stop and restart to retry unavailable tracking or recognition.

The camera and vowel model run offline; this app does not record or upload video. Words, sentences, speech output, and translation history remain future work.

Vowel refinement (debug builds): Open Collect vowel samples in the overflow menu. Scroll to the session controls, choose Training session, and tap Start selected session. Start the camera and follow the letter/hand prompts. Each capture gives one second to prepare and records two seconds of landmarks. Complete 80 holds, then export the samples ZIP. Repeat in a separate Validation session with different lighting/background. Reserve Final test session until a candidate is frozen. No photos, video, or audio are saved; export is manual. The original recognition model remains active until a replacement passes evaluation.
